name: Del Cerro Pizza
notes: Read from schema.org JSON-LD on the restaurant's own Slice storefront, linked from delcerropizzas.com. The router filed this as needs-browser; the JSON-LD is present under a browser UA. Prices are whole dollars on 41 of 50 items, so no delivery uplift is present (an uplifted Slice menu shows the .20/.40/.60/.80 tail). The first-party site lists the same dish names and descriptions but carries no prices.
